baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both focus words carry ذ ر و, with an agentive plural followed by its cognate accusative, so the action and its manner dominate the line.
baseline_models.mechanism: A moving medium lifts a mixed mass, broadcasts it, and thereby separates its components; dispersion is functional sorting rather than mere loss.

activation_trace.role: Wind-driven winnowing literally lifts and separates a heap, supplying the baseline separation mechanism.
The grain image makes the dispersed material potentially useful seed or food, not only dust.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified group scatters something intensely.
changed_reading.after: Agents perform an aerial sorting operation, breaking a mass open so its units can be separated and redirected.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same repeated root can profile what is detached from a support as well as what is carried away.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dispersion begins with ejection: particles are stripped from an edge, cast off, and made to fall into a new field.

activation_trace.role: Casting, dropping, and knocking an edge away supply the forceful detachment at the start of dispersal.
Projecting extremities provide the literal edge from which material can be shaken loose.

changed_reading.after: Scattering is an act of severance and shedding from exposed edges, with a fall implicit in the release.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The participial plural permits the focus to profile moving agents, while the cognate accusative intensifies their mode of passage.
baseline_models.mechanism: The agents are read as a fast-moving swarm or current whose transit itself creates dispersion.

activation_trace.role: Rapid passing literally supplies velocity and makes transit, rather than residue, the foregrounded event.

changed_reading.before: The line names scatterers by their effect on an object.
changed_reading.after: The line can name swift passers whose collective motion is itself a spreading current.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A focus-root branch names a partial saying that falls from the edges of speech.
baseline_models.mechanism: A whole utterance loses cohesion and travels as detached verbal particles, making dispersal linguistic as well as material.

activation_trace.role: An incomplete edge-fragment of speech literally supplies verbal particles that can be scattered.

changed_reading.before: Only physical particles are blown apart.
changed_reading.after: Speech itself can be atomized into circulating fragments that no longer preserve a complete saying.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root also contains a lee or protecting cover, creating an internal polarity between exposure to wind and refuge from it.
baseline_models.mechanism: Scattering marks the outside of shelter: to be carried away is to have left, lost, or been removed from a protective lee.

activation_trace.role: A windbreak, shade, or patron's protection supplies the sheltered state whose loss makes dispersal possible.
Wind-driven scattering supplies the exposed counter-state outside that protection.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes motion without a spatial contrast.
changed_reading.after: The focus stages the threshold between protected enclosure and wind-exposed dispersal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening four lines form a plausible process chain: separate a mass, consolidate it as a load, move it in a compliant flow, then allot its units under an ordering act.

activation_trace.role: Winnowing literally separates a mixed heap and functions as the chain's first transformation.
Bearing a visible load supplies consolidation and transportability after separation.
A heavy burden gives the newly consolidated material measurable weight.
Flowing or running supplies continuous conveyance rather than another burst of scattering.
Light, compliant motion specifies low-resistance movement through the transport stage.
Separating assigned shares supplies the terminal redistribution toward destinations.
An obligating command supplies governance for what would otherwise look like random motion.

structural_cues: 51:1-4 repeat feminine plural participles with indefinite accusative complements.
The ف transitions after 51:1 permit, without requiring, a staged sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched forms and separation, load, flow, and allotment images; I supply the directional arrow of a logistics pipeline. A live alternative is four parallel classes rather than successive stages.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a free-standing image of random atmospheric dispersal.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the opening operation in an ordered material economy: loosen and sort now so loading, movement, and allocation can follow.

context_deltas.mechanism: What is cast loose does not vanish; it enters a trajectory that ends in a fixed landing. Promise, verified performance, reckoning, and occurrence turn the focus's shedding into a material analogy for inevitable arrival.

activation_trace.role: Casting and dropping literally initiate a trajectory and function as the focus-side premise of eventual landing.
A spoken promise opens expectation toward a future object and supplies the pending destination.
Fulfilling a promise in action supplies closure between announced and realized states.
Accounting and recompense make the landing consequential rather than merely physical.
Falling and becoming fixed literally complete the trajectory released by the focus.

structural_cues: 51:5-6 switch from processive oath images to emphatic assertions about what will prove true and occur.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies casting, promise, fulfillment, reckoning, and fixed falling; I infer one trajectory from release to arrival. Alternatively, the opening phenomena may only witness certainty without modeling its mechanics.

changed_reading.before: To scatter is to lose material into indefinite distance.
changed_reading.after: To scatter is to release material into a governed arc whose eventual settling figures the promised event's fixed arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The medium of dispersal is not empty space but an elevated, tightly made field of intersecting routes; particles spread by following a patterned mesh.

activation_trace.role: Wind-driven scattering supplies mobile particles and the apparent disorder to be revised.
The over-arching sky supplies the elevated medium in which the movement occurs.
Tightly fashioned, interlacing paths literally supply channels that pattern the spread.
Firm binding makes those routes a coherent mesh rather than accidental crossings.

structural_cues: 51:7 resumes an oath form after the four-part process and the certainty claims.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aerial scattering and a sky characterized by interwoven paths; I infer channelled flow through that mesh. The alternative is simple juxtaposition of two independent oath objects.

changed_reading.before: Scattered units move chaotically wherever the wind sends them.
changed_reading.after: The apparent scatter is a many-path distribution across an underlying woven order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's verbal fragments become a social-cognitive field: conjectural sayings break apart, take incompatible routes, redirect hearers, and accumulate into a covering medium of heedlessness.

activation_trace.role: Detached edges of an incomplete saying literally supply the units of discursive scatter.
A saying that operates as conjecture supplies uncertain verbal material rather than settled testimony.
Rattling agitation, preserved by the split mapping, makes the conflicted saying behave like shaken particles.
Each party taking a different route supplies divergence among the circulating fragments.
Winds blowing from differing bearings give the discourse a literal cross-current image.
Turning something away from its direction supplies the fragments' effect on hearers.
A covering haze of falsehood and ignorance supplies the medium produced by accumulated fragments.
Heedlessness of the heart supplies the cognitive state maintained by that haze.

structural_cues: 51:8 explicitly places its audience inside a divergent saying.
The uncitable branchless root خ ر ص at 51:10 word 2 structurally sharpens the sequence from divergent speech to guesswork.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech fragments, conjectural saying, divergent routes, crosswinds, redirection, ignorance, and heedlessness; I infer a causal ecology in which circulated fragments sustain confusion. They could instead be separate descriptions of error.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts only particles dispersed by wind.
changed_reading.after: It also diagrams discourse dispersed into incompatible, redirecting fragments: a weather system of unstable claims.

context_deltas.mechanism: Winnowing and assay become parallel separation technologies: one exposes a heap to moving air, the other exposes a substance or person to fire and experience, and both reveal what survives the test.

activation_trace.role: Winnowing literally separates mixed material and supplies the focus-side sorting operation.
Kindled fire supplies the second testing medium.
Assaying metal or a person literally supplies testing by exposure and functions as discriminative sorting.
Experiencing and undergoing a thing makes the test embodied rather than observational.
Hastening supplies premature demand for the assay's result before its process arrives.

structural_cues: The temporal question in 51:12 is answered by an enacted scene in 51:13-14.
The repeated ف ت ن across 51:13-14 shifts from being tested to possessing the test.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies winnowing, fire, assay, embodied trial, and haste; I infer a shared reveal-by-exposure mechanism. The alternative is that material sorting and punitive testing remain unrelated domains.

changed_reading.before: The focus separates light particles from a physical mixture.
changed_reading.after: The focus prefigures a broader assay: exposure disperses protective cohesion so the composition of what was mixed becomes manifest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The root-internal opposition between wind exposure and shelter becomes ethical-spatial: the scattered state is outside protection, while the later garden and forgiveness restore layered cover.

activation_trace.role: A lee, shade, or patronal cover supplies the focus root's latent protected state.
Wind exposure supplies the opposed state in which unprotected material is carried away.
Repelling harm through protection turns shelter into an active boundary.
A garden hidden by its trees supplies an inhabited, vegetative enclosure after exposure.
Covering a fault while protecting its bearer supplies a moral form of restored shelter.

structural_cues: 51:15-18 reverse the preceding exposure scene into gardens, reception, night practice, and pre-dawn seeking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus-root shelter branch and later protection, enclosed garden, and protective covering; I infer exposure and refuge as opposed states. The alternative is a lexical side-current with no role in the focus syntax.

changed_reading.before: Scattering has no implied destination or counter-state.
changed_reading.after: Scattering marks removal from cover, making later protection readable as a deliberate reversal of exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The material sequence acquires a social destination: a stored mass is separated into shares, and the share moves outward not as waste but as a claim owed to an asker and one deprived.

activation_trace.role: Grain supplies a divisible store whose outward scattering can become distribution rather than depletion.
The apportioning of distinct shares supplies the allocation rule.
Accumulated wealth supplies the consolidated stock from which units can be released.
A specific right owned by its bearer makes outward transfer obligatory rather than optional generosity.
Request and asking identify one channel through which the due share is drawn outward.
Deprivation and missing the sought object identify the recipient whose absent share must be restored.

structural_cues: 51:19 places a right inside wealth before naming two recipient conditions.
The earlier sequence ends in apportionment, allowing the later right to specify what that apportionment is for.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grain, apportioned shares, accumulated wealth, a proprietary right, asking, and deprivation; I infer release from stock to claimant as one redistribution mechanism. The alternative is only a thematic echo between unrelated material and legal registers.

changed_reading.before: The focus's separated units have no social owner or destination.
changed_reading.after: Scattering can figure deconcentration: opening a stored mass so owed units reach those from whom possession has been withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The winnowing image reverses from depletion into broadcast. Sky-borne distribution marks receptive earth with growth, turns scattered grain or rain into provision, and lets a future promise arrive through material circulation.

activation_trace.role: Wind-driven broadcast supplies the transport that can carry productive matter outward.
Grain supplies the productive particle whose dispersal can seed rather than erase.
Soft, germinating earth supplies the receptive destination for what is broadcast.
The sky as what rises and covers supplies the source field above the receptive earth.
First rain marking earth with vegetation, preserved by the split mapping, directly links descent from above to visible growth.
Rain descending as provision makes aerial distribution nutritionally productive.
Provision as an apportioned gift joins broadcast back to the allocation mechanism.
A promising sign from which a coming state is expected makes the material cycle anticipatory.

structural_cues: 51:20 places signs in the earth, while 51:22 places provision and promise in the sky.
The vertical sky-earth frame gives the focus's outward motion a source and a receptive destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies broadcast, grain, germinating earth, sky, growth-marking rain, provision, and future sign; I infer one delivery ecology connecting them. Provision could instead be located above without wind or seed mediation.

changed_reading.before: Wind scattering thins a stock and carries it away.
changed_reading.after: Wind scattering broadcasts provision across a receptive field, so apparent loss is the transport stage of growth and apportioned arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unreliable speech-scatter reading gains a competing reversal: distributed units in earth and self can be seen as signs whose patterned agreement becomes a nonverbal utterance, culminating in truth likened to one's own speech.

activation_trace.role: Fragments falling from the edge of speech supply distributed sign-units rather than one complete proposition.
A manifest sign makes each distributed unit potentially legible.
Insight of the heart supplies the integrative perception needed to read dispersed marks together.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the criterion that distinguishes these signs from conjectural fragments.
Resemblance supplies the bridge by which material indication is compared to ordinary speech.
A sign that speaks by indication turns the distributed field into articulate evidence without requiring literal words.

structural_cues: 51:20-21 distribute signs across earth and selves, then ask for perception.
51:23 seals the unit with an oath and an explicit comparison to the audience's speaking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispersed speech-fragments, visible signs, inward insight, real correspondence, resemblance, and speaking indication; I infer composition of many marks into one evidentiary utterance. Alternatively, the final speech comparison marks certainty only.

changed_reading.before: Scattered fragments necessarily degrade a coherent message.
changed_reading.after: Scattered units can also compose a distributed utterance: individually partial, collectively articulate, and readable as concordant evidence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus is grammatically easier to hear as impersonal dispersers, while the tear branch redirects it toward human devotion. It remains anchored in a focus-root image of poured tears and is activated by flowing water, night, pre-dawn, and protective forgiveness; downstream prose should present it as an affective echo, not a replacement construal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root explicitly carries the pouring of tears, allowing the agentive plural to flicker as those who shed them intensely.

activation_trace.role: Tears pouring from the eye literally supply the outlier's human, affective form of scattering.
A flowing spring supplies a larger water image that reactivates the focus's smaller ocular flow.
Night and its darkness supply the temporal enclosure in which the devotional act occurs.
The pre-dawn portion of night narrows that act to a liminal time.
Seeking a covering that protects from a fault's effect supplies the tears' devotional aim.

changed_reading.before: The oath begins with wind scattering external matter.
changed_reading.after: At the affective edge, it can echo wakeful seekers pouring tears before dawn as they seek protective covering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it pivots from ordinary scattering to the specialized act of shearing while deliberately leaving wool as a marker. It remains focus-root anchored and becomes functional beside visible signs and insight; downstream prose should label it a selective-removal analogy, not lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A specialized focus-root branch joins removal to the deliberate preservation of a residual mark.

activation_trace.role: Shearing wool while leaving a strip as a sign literally supplies selective removal that preserves evidence.
A manifest sign makes the intentionally retained remainder communicative.
Inward insight supplies recognition that the remainder is a marker rather than an accidental leftover.

changed_reading.after: A strange specialized echo makes removal selective: most is stripped away so a retained trace becomes legible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because summit and projecting-edge branches are not the focus's most immediate verbal sense. It remains anchored in two focus-root spatial images and gains a coherent vertical route through sky, fixed falling, and earth; downstream prose should qualify it as spatial topology activated by context.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root can locate action at an elevated summit or projecting extremity before anything is cast from it.

activation_trace.role: A summit or eminent height supplies the upper origin of the motion.
A projecting extremity supplies the lip from which material is released.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the downward trajectory and terminal settling.
Elevation supplies the upper spatial register around the projecting origin.
The lower realm opposed to sky supplies the trajectory's receiving plane.

changed_reading.before: The focus spreads material horizontally across an undefined field.
changed_reading.after: It can also sketch a vertical cascade from a high projecting rim through open sky toward a fixed earthly landing.

strongest_changes: 51:2-4 recast scattering as the first stage of an ordered separation, transport, and allocation chain.
51:5-7 turn apparent randomness into governed trajectory and woven-path distribution.
51:8-11 activate a coexisting discursive reading in which conjectural speech circulates as redirecting fragments.
51:20-23 reverse fragmentation again: dispersed signs can compose articulate, reality-matching evidence.
51:19 and 51:22 make outward dispersal productive as due-share redistribution and provision broadcast.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated focus root held unusually strong internal oppositions: winnowing versus grain, casting versus fixed landing, exposure versus shelter, and broken speech versus speaking indication. Context did not collapse these; it organized them into competing material, social, epistemic, and devotional mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The four opening participial clauses may be sequential stages, parallel witnesses, or both.
The speech-fragment and shelter activations are lexically anchored but remain form-distant from the most immediate focus construal.
The provision model requires a reader-supplied causal link between wind distribution, rain or seed, and growth.
The tear, shearing-mark, and high-edge readings should remain exploratory echoes unless independent linguistic evidence strengthens them.
